uutiset.t: Northern Ireland promoted to Nations League top tier with draw in Hungary
uutiset.s: Justin Devenny's superb strike saw Northern Ireland earn promotion to the top tier of the Nations League with a hard-fought 1-1 draw away to closest challengers Hungary in Budapest.

uutiset.t: Parrott fires Republic of Ireland into Nations League play-offs
uutiset.s: Troy Parrott fired the Republic of Ireland into a Nations League play-off berth with two penalties in their 3-0 victory over 10-man Kosovo at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin.

uutiset.t: Wales beaten by 10-man Portugal as Neto scores but is sent off
uutiset.s: Wales ended their Nations League group campaign with a 3-2 defeat against 10-man Portugal in Cardiff after Chelsea's Pedro Neto was sent off.
